context:
Add group-qualified accessible names to Query facet controls while preserving compact visible text. Desktop Query
checkboxes should expose names like `Deployment: local (205)` and `Cost status: not_applicable_local (205)` without
changing the rendered value/count layout. Shared mobile `FacetRail` checkboxes should follow the same group/value
naming pattern using their existing formatted display labels. Keep facet query generation, URL parameter names, and
visible facet labels unchanged.

Process cleanup: check free space before and after verification. If available space is below 40GB, remove loaded
local database artifacts under `benchmark_runs/databases/` when present, but preserve reusable generated data under
`benchmark_runs/datagen/` because TPC-H and derived/read-primitive runs can reuse it. Stop only if available space
falls below 5GB.
description:
The W6 Playwright smoke had to use the exact accessible name `local 205`
because a partial label match for Deployment `local` also matched Cost status
`not_applicable_local`. This is a minor but real accessibility and automation
rough edge in the Query facet rail.

anti_patterns.dont: solve this by hiding cost or deployment facets
anti_patterns.why: both are needed for corpus filtering

preserves.behavior: Screen-reader accessible names remain descriptive enough to identify facet group and value.
Visible facet labels stay compact for dense desktop and mobile layouts.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 e2e/routes/query.spec.ts
verifications.description: Targeted browser smoke can select Deployment local without strict-mode ambiguity.

work_units.notes:
Inventory findings:
- Query desktop filters are implemented locally in `results-explorer/src/pages/Query.tsx` via `FacetSection`
  and `SingleFacetSection`. `FacetSection` checkboxes currently rely on implicit label text, so the accessible
  name includes the visible value plus the trailing count, e.g. `local 205`.
- Query mobile filters are built from `mobileFacetGroups` in `results-explorer/src/pages/Query.tsx` and rendered
  by `results-explorer/src/components/FacetRail.tsx`. `FacetRail` currently sets checkbox `aria-label` to the
  formatted option label without the facet group, so values like `local` can still collide semantically across
  Deployment and Cost status.
- The reusable display formatter is `results-explorer/src/lib/facetDisplay.ts`, but Query desktop facets do not
  use it. Keep this TODO narrowly focused on accessible names rather than changing visible labels or display
  formatting.
- Existing component coverage for normalized cost/deployment facets lives in
  `results-explorer/src/pages/__tests__/Query.test.tsx`; browser coverage and helper lookup live in
  `results-explorer/e2e/routes/query.spec.ts`.
